authorization.scope: Continue saved Double DQN, select on validation only, new locked policy, unused held-out teams and fresh seeds; preserve PR12 completed results

resume: Exact saved online/target/Adam/RNG/replay state; no optimizer reset; continue episode indices from457

training.clock: Persistent deadline per stage; all stages clipped to research cutoff; recovery never resets allocation

selection.candidates: initial plus each complete stage endpoint; earliest listed wins point-score ties

reliable_win_criterion: Both mixed lower95>.5 and standard upper95>=.5; all three blocks complete
test_distribution: Original test fold9 conditioned on compositions absent from all prior final games, sampled with replacement; not a paired cross-study comparison
final_lock: One new run-local policy/source/data/selection/holdout/count/deadline lock before any new final game; never alter old global lock or old results
admission: Always complete one honest fixed benchmark if time permits, even when validation loses; no relaxed strength target
time_reserve: Stop research at35h after approval, leaving13h for canary/final/closure; no extension beyond48h
failure_recovery: Same atomic checkpoints, replay, RNG, stage deadlines and immutable runtime; no duplicate worker; preserve logs
